terms.cradle: General O:I operating field that provides authored ground, Agency, context/body/harness resolution, developmental runtime, materialisation and formal/refraction powers. Final terminology still requires ratification.
terms.epi_application_harness: Higher Epi-specific inhabitation/application layer: six canonical agent identities, VAK/CF grammar, Bimba/Pratibimba semantics, domain Skills/tools, dialogue, lived surfaces and return. Distinct from AIKit Harness/HarnessComposition providers.
terms.s_base: Historical technical capability substrate; generic portions preferentially migrate into or bind to native O:I owners.
terms.s_prime: Historical Epi-aware augmentation/reflection law; candidate modern role is refractive/profile/application binding over O:I-native capability rather than a second generic substrate.
terms.m_prime: Lived semantic/domain Pratibimba software; never reduced to S-prime or to provider identity.
